# k0rdent_cluster_types (Data Source)

Every ClusterType available in a region.

This is the catalog a cluster is created from: an entry's `self_link` is what a `k0rdent_kubernetes_cluster` resource's `cluster_type` takes. It needs a region but no project: the catalog is region-wide and scoped only by the token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "k0rdent_cluster_types" "all" {}

# Available types with "gpu" in the name. `(?i)` makes the match
# case-insensitive. The order isn't fixed, so look entries up by id.
data "k0rdent_cluster_types" "gpu" {
  status             = "available"
  display_name_regex = "(?i)gpu"
}

output "gpu_cluster_types" {
  value = { for t in data.k0rdent_cluster_types.gpu.cluster_types : t.id => t.self_link }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `display_name_regex` (String) Return only the ClusterTypes whose `display_name` matches this regular expression, in the RE2 syntax Terraform's own `regex` function takes. The match isn't anchored, so `prod` finds `preprod-a`: write `^prod-` for a prefix. One with no `display_name` never matches. Filtered in the provider, after the whole list is read: the list operation takes no such filter. **Constraints:** Must be a regular expression in RE2 syntax.
- `include_deprecated` (Boolean) Include ClusterType versions whose status is `deprecated`, which the platform hides by default.
- `region` (String) Region to read. Defaults to the provider's `region`. Region ids come from `GET /v1/regions`. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.
- `status` (String) Return only the ClusterTypes whose `status` is this value. Filtered in the provider, after the whole list is read: the list operation takes no such filter. `deprecated` asks the platform for deprecated types too, so it doesn't need `include_deprecated` beside it, and `include_deprecated = false` beside it is refused at plan, since the pair can only answer an empty list. **Constraints:** Value must be one of: ["draft" "available" "deprecated"].

### Read-Only

- `cluster_types` (Attributes List) The catalog. Sorted by `id`, then `self_link`. The order holds across reads, but a new entry sorting above an existing one shifts every index below it, so iterate with `for_each` rather than reading `cluster_types[0]`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster_types))

<a id="nestedatt--cluster_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cluster_types`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Free-form text describing it, for people to read, when one was set.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name, for display only.
- `id` (String) The ClusterType's id, its slug in the region's catalog.
- `self_link` (String) Reference to this ClusterType, suitable for a cluster's `cluster_type`. Head-scoped, so it binds whatever the current version is.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status of the latest version: `available`, `draft` or `deprecated`.
- `version` (Number) Sequential version number, for display.
